meta.description: Eligibility-filtered temporal sidecar for the PPA poets Sigma/Graphology website. Slices are PPA publication windows; layout and communities come from the archive-wide Gephi graph.
meta.first_ppa_mention_note: node_meta.first_ppa_mention is the first observed eligible PPA mention for each poet, with a work-level source_url when available and page equal to the first mention-bearing window start page.
meta.top_ppa_work_note: node_meta.top_ppa_work is the eligible PPA work with the most mention-bearing windows for each poet; this is a sustained-presence measure, not a raw mention count.
meta.eligibility_rule: A poet is active only in works whose publication year is >= max(DOB + AGE_MIN, archive_start); missing DOB is treated as eligible from archive_start.
